due_when.clears_when: backfill_monitor_closed_pnl.py::_plan_row refuses (or flags for manual review) a recovered closed_pnl whose sign contradicts the trade's own entry->exit price move, the same way backfill_orphan_pnl.py::_plan_row already does — ported verbatim or via a shared helper so the two cannot drift apart again.

terminal_reason: FIX-CA-19 fixed in PR #13246: the sign-consistency guard is ported verbatim into backfill_monitor_closed_pnl._plan_row; test_sign_mismatch_refuses_write + the fabricated-loss mirror (fail on main 7d002927).
what: [trading-correctness] scripts/ops/backfill_monitor_closed_pnl.py::_plan_row writes Bybit-recovered pnl/exit_price directly with NO sign-consistency guard, while its sibling backfill_orphan_pnl.py::_plan_row (calling the SAME account_closed_pnl_for_trade lookup) has an explicit guard added 2026-06-20 after a real incident where the lookup returned a mismatched record (every long on a demo account resolving to an identical +3847.29 regardless of actual exit). This script is dispatchable for real accounts via the system-actions workflow (`backfill-monitor-closed-pnl` -> backfill_monitor_closed_pnl_action.sh --apply), so the same failure mode can write a fabricated profit/loss to a real trade's pnl/exit_price with no defense. Filed by code-audit lane CA-A11 (docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A11.findings.jsonl, finding AUD-20260927-CA-A11-backfill-monitor-sign-guard).
